title: Docs Generate Executor
description: Inferred on a project tagged generate:docs-site. Render the static API reference site from a document openapi-generate wrote, with the consumer's own @webpieces/docs-site, into <projectRoot>/<siteDir> (gitignored, for hosting — not packed into the package).

document.description: The document openapi-generate wrote to render, e.g. public-openapi.json. No default.

siteDir.description: The site's directory relative to the project root, e.g. generated-docs. Emptied and rewritten on every run; gitignore it. No default.

prose.description: Workspace-relative directory holding docs.manifest.json and the markdown it names. Optional: a site with no prose pages is legal.
